title: proton-drive-cli bridge auth-state payload
description: Success payload of `bridge auth-state`: readiness of the saved browser-fork session. session_invalid means session.json is not a session written by `proton-drive-cli login` (non-blank uid, credentialHost and revision, credentialStore git-credential or pass-cli). session_expired means the access token expired locally; bridge init refreshes it before use. willAttemptNetwork is always false: proton-drive-cli sends no request to the Proton API and refreshes no token for auth-state. credentialsAvailable comes from reading the session's entry (tokens and key password) from its credential store; pass-cli can contact Proton Pass to do so. errors carries the store's reason when the entry could not be read.
